## Core SDLC squad

| Agent | Title | Division | Tools | Mission |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `product_strategist` | Product Strategist | sdlc_strategy | r | Turn a raw idea, ticket or feature request into a crisp product requirements brief. |
| `architect` | Software Architect | sdlc_strategy | rw | Design how a change fits into the system. |
| `tech_lead` | Tech Lead | sdlc_strategy | r | Convert requirements and design into an executable implementation plan. |
| `developer` | Software Engineer | sdlc_engineering | rwx | Implement the plan. |
| `frontend_engineer` | Frontend Engineer | sdlc_engineering | rwx | Build and fix user-interface code: components, state, styling and client-side logic. |
| `data_engineer` | Data Engineer | sdlc_engineering | rwx | Own schemas, migrations, queries and data pipelines. |
| `refactorer` | Refactoring Specialist | sdlc_engineering | rwx | Improve the structure of code without changing behaviour. |
| `bug_hunter` | Bug Hunter | sdlc_engineering | rwx | Find and fix defects. |
| `code_reviewer` | Code Reviewer | sdlc_quality | r | Review the current change set (use git_diff; fall back to the files named in context) like a senior engineer. |
| `test_engineer` | Test Engineer | sdlc_quality | rwx | Make sure the change is properly tested. |
| `qa_validator` | QA Validator | sdlc_quality | rx | Act as the acceptance gate. |
| `performance_analyst` | Performance Analyst | sdlc_quality | rx | Hunt for performance problems: algorithmic complexity on hot paths, repeated I/O in loops, N+1 queries, unbounded memory growth, blocking calls in async code, and missing caching or pagination. |
| `security_auditor` | Security Auditor | sdlc_security | r | Audit code for vulnerabilities: injection (SQL, command, template), XSS, SSRF, path traversal, insecure deserialization, broken authentication or authorization, secrets in code or config, weak crypto, unsafe defaults, and sensitive data in logs. |
| `dependency_auditor` | Dependency Auditor | sdlc_security | rx | Inspect dependency manifests and lockfiles (requirements, pyproject, package.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml, ...). |
| `threat_modeler` | Threat Modeler | sdlc_security | r | Build a threat model of the system or proposed design using STRIDE. |
| `devops_engineer` | DevOps Engineer | sdlc_operations | rw | Own build, CI/CD and runtime packaging. |
| `release_manager` | Release Manager | sdlc_operations | rw | Prepare releases. |
| `incident_responder` | Incident Responder | sdlc_operations | rx | Respond to production incidents. |
| `observability_engineer` | Observability Engineer | sdlc_operations | rw | Make the system debuggable in production. |
| `docs_writer` | Technical Writer | sdlc_knowledge | rw | Keep documentation true and useful. |
| `api_documenter` | API Documenter | sdlc_knowledge | rw | Produce accurate API reference documentation from the code: endpoints or public functions, parameters, types, return values, errors and examples. |
| `onboarding_guide` | Onboarding Guide | sdlc_knowledge | r | Explain the codebase to a new engineer. |
| `issue_triager` | Issue Triager | sdlc_maintenance | r | Triage an incoming issue or bug report. |
| `tech_debt_scout` | Tech Debt Scout | sdlc_maintenance | r | Survey the codebase for technical debt: dead code, TODO/FIXME/HACK markers, duplicated logic, oversized modules, outdated patterns, missing tests around critical code, and inconsistent conventions. |
